findings: obligation_coverage: Reconstructed the radial route from the smooth-manifold baseline and canonical targets, then compared it with S01 obligations O01–O28. Actual repairs include the radial differential's t factor, current-to-initial inverse A^{-1}, Gram density, singular scalar boundary term, ball substitution, angular limit, absolute continuity and the independent spherical endpoint. O01–O20 now have explicit operations; O21–O25 await integration of the global candidate. The [reader entrance](knowledge/overview.md#reader-entrance-and-available-operations) and [density construction](knowledge/nodes/N-D-jacobi.md#from-the-radial-differential-to-volume-density) show the repair rather than merely naming it. Broader gaps retain their status.

fast_route_reconstruction: The actual answer recovered from the fast text was S to m to j/s_k^{n-1} to the zero-truncated angular average q to its positive weighted average; each transition has a reason. Matrix-order comparison is not a prerequisite for the Ricci trace route. Myers is needed only to close the positive-k endpoint. With k=0 the reader task yields Vol B(p,2r) <= 2^n Vol B(p,r), but no absolute lower volume constant. The [six-step route](knowledge/overview.md#ricci-lower-bounds-to-ball-volume) contains the evidence. This was author reconstruction with prior knowledge, not an observed novice test.

slow_step_reproduction: Recomputed dPhi(partial_t)=T and dPhi(w)=Aw, the block metric diag(1,A^T A), density |det A| and its positive sign before conjugacy. Recomputed mu~Ct^2 and u=O(t), hence mu(epsilon)u(epsilon)->0, yielding m <= (n-1)c_k. Finally N/W is locally absolutely continuous, F >= q and F'=(w/W)(q-F)<=0 almost everywhere. See [radial differential](knowledge/nodes/N-D-jacobi.md#radial-variation-and-the-exponential-differential), [singular comparison](knowledge/nodes/N-M-trace.md#singular-scalar-comparison-by-an-integrating-factor) and [weighted average](knowledge/nodes/N-M-cut-integration.md#a-positive-weighted-average). The separate [endpoint field calculation](knowledge/nodes/N-D-index.md#an-endpoint-field-calculation) was also reproduced from I(J,W)=0 and the model ODE.

condition_transfer: Under sectional-to-Ricci replacement the operator inequality fails first, while the trace route survives; S2xS2 supplies the actual directional counterexample. Under a Ricci upper bound, the term -Q prevents the required reverse scalar inequality. Without cut truncation a cylinder creates multiplicity in the ball substitution; under a reversed raywise lower estimate the downward cut jump destroys that estimate. At s_k=0 division stops and the terminal-sphere/saturation argument replaces it. See [trace failure](knowledge/nodes/N-M-trace.md#what-the-hypotheses-do-not-give), [geometric failures](knowledge/nodes/N-M-cut-integration.md#one-use-and-the-first-failing-conditions) and [positive endpoint](knowledge/nodes/N-M-cut-integration.md#the-positive-curvature-endpoint). The record distinguishes these failed proof operations from the concrete counterexamples.
